newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Services plans MGM Service acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Services plans MGM Service acquisition.

text.p: Industrial Services of America Inc said Thursday it has entered into a letter of intent to acquire MGM Services Inc, a full service auditing and recycling company, with annual sales in excess of $12 million.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The company said that while the consummation of the acquisition is subject to certain conditions, it expects it to close before March 31.

Industrial Services also said the acquisition of MGM should generate significant economies of scale, expand its annualized revenues by more than 35 percent, and have a positive impact on 1997 earnings.
